findings.message: GSAP timeline is created but never registered in window.__timelines. The runtime discovers timelines from this registry. Without registration, animations will not play during preview or render.
findings.fixHint: Add `window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};` and `window.__timelines["root"] = tl;` after creating the timeline (use the composition's data-composition-id as the key).

findings.message: <section id="scene-1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="s1-tag">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section id="scene-1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
